description: This Java source file contains utility methods for handling Android DOM elements within the IntelliJ IDEA plugin environment, including resource type resolution, converters, and DOM element processing.

classes.name: AndroidDomUtil
classes.description: Utility class providing methods for Android DOM element processing, resource type resolution, and converters within IntelliJ IDEA plugin.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the Android resource type string corresponding to a given attribute format.

methods.name: getStringConverter
methods.description: Provides a converter for string values based on attribute format.

methods.name: getResourceReferenceConverter
methods.description: Creates a resource reference converter based on attribute definitions and formats.

methods.name: simplify
methods.description: Simplifies a composite converter to a single converter if possible.

methods.name: getSpecificConverter
methods.description: Returns a specific converter for an attribute based on its name and context.

methods.name: getConverter
methods.description: Constructs a comprehensive converter for an attribute definition.

methods.name: getSpecialResourceType
methods.description: Returns a manually registered special resource type for an attribute name.

methods.name: addSpecialResourceType
methods.description: Registers a new special resource type for specific attribute names.

methods.name: containsAction
methods.description: Checks if an intent filter contains a specific action.

methods.name: containsCategory
methods.description: Checks if an intent filter contains a specific category.

methods.name: getActivityDomElementByClass
methods.description: Finds an activity DOM element matching a given PsiClass.

methods.name: getStaticallyDefinedSubtags
methods.description: Returns statically defined subtags for various Android DOM elements.

methods.name: getAttributeDefinition
methods.description: Retrieves attribute definition from resource manager based on XML attribute.

methods.name: removeUnambigiousNames
methods.description: Filters view class map to remove ambiguous class names.

methods.name: getAndroidResourceReference
methods.description: Gets an Android resource reference from a resource value attribute.

methods.name: findComponentDeclarationInManifest
methods.description: Finds the component declaration in the Android manifest for a given PsiClass.

methods.name: isInheritor
methods.description: Checks if a PsiClass inherits from a specified base class.
